text: {"lessons":["Selling winners can feel satisfying, but a gain versus my average cost alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider the investment and portfolio as a whole.","Recent price moves are random and do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term account swings or trying to time the market.","Buying back shares soon after selling them shows how easily frequent trading can undo a decision; I should make deliberate trades and respect my cash and share limits."]}
